safi-cedvel:1-2.t:
* I'rab:
(تنزيل) a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: or it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هو, i.e. the Qur'an.. and likewise the clause «لا ريب فيه» and the preposition and its genitive noun (من ربّ العالمين); so they are three independent clauses.], its khabar being (من ربّ), (لا) the lā of generic negation, (ريب) the noun of لا, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of an accusative, (فيه) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of لا, (من رب) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ تنزيل [Note: or it is a khabar after a khabar.. and it may be attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (فيه)].
The clause «تنزيل الكتاب ...» has no grammatical position: initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «لا ريب فيه..» has no grammatical position: parenthetical [Note: or it is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl of الكتاب.].

safi-cedvel:3-3.t:
* I'rab:
(أم) is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, meaning بل together with the hamza, (بل) for iḍrāb (digression) of cancellation (ibṭālī) of their saying افتراه, (من ربّك) attached to (mutaʿalliq) الحقّ — or to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of it —, (اللام) of causation, (تنذر) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām.. and the second object is implied, its implied form being العقاب (the punishment).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن تنذر) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being أنزلناه.
(ما) negative, (نذير) genitive (majrūr) in its outward form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, the fāʿil (agent) of أتاهم, (من قبلك) attached to (أتاهم) [Note: or attached to a naʿt (adjective) of نذير.].
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «افتراه ...» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «هو الحقّ ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تنذر قوما..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «ما أتاهم من نذير..» is in the position of an accusative as a naʿt of (قوما).
The clause «لعلّهم يهتدون..» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يهتدون..» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.

safi-cedvel:4-9.t:
* I'rab:
(الذي) a relative noun, the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) الله, in the position of a nominative, (الواو) conjunction in the three places, (ما) a relative noun in the position of an accusative, conjoined to السموات, (بينهما) an adverb, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما, (في ستة) attached to (خلق), (ثمّ) a conjunction, (على العرش) attached to (استوى), (ما) negative, (لكم) attached to an omitted fronted khabar, (وليّ) genitive (majrūr) in its outward form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ, (لا) redundant (zāʾida) to emphasise the negation, (الهمزة) for the interrogative, (الفاء) conjunction, (لا) negative..
The clause «الله الذي ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «خلق ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «استوى ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause خلق.
The clause «ما لكم من دونه..» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: the clause may be the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله), and the relative (الذي) is then a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty or a badal (substitute).].
The clause «تتذكّرون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.: have you been heedless, so you do not remember ...
(5) (من السماء) attached to (يدبّر) by its being made to contain (taḍmīn) the meaning of ينقل (transfers), (إلى الأرض) attached to (يدبّر), (إليه) attached to (يعرج), and the fāʿil (agent) of يعرج is a pronoun referring to الأمر, (في يوم) attached to (يعرج), (ممّا) attached to a naʿt of ألف سنة.
The clause «يدبّر..» is in the position of a nominative as another khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «يعرج..» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause يدبّر.
The clause «كان مقداره ألف ...» is in the position of a genitive as a naʿt of يوم.
The clause «تعدّون..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
(6) (ذلك) a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is عالم, (العزيز) a second khabar, nominative, (الرحيم) a third khabar, nominative.
The clause «ذلك عالم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
(7) (الذي) a relative noun in the position of a nominative, a fourth khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك [Note: or it is a naʿt of الرحيم.], (من طين) attached to (بدأ).
The clause «أحسن ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (الذي).
The clause «بدأ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أحسن.
The clause «خلقه ...» is in the position of an accusative as a naʿt of كلّ.. or in the position of a genitive as a naʿt of شيء.
(8) (من سلالة) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being جعل, (من ماء) attached to a naʿt of سلالة.
The clause «جعل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause بدأ.
(9) (فيه) attached to (نفخ), (من روحه) attached to (نفخ), and the annexation of the spirit to Him the Exalted is for honouring, (لكم) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi, its governor being جعل, (قليلا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), its governor being تشكرون, (ما) redundant, to emphasise the paucity.
The clause «سوّاه ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause جعل.
The clause «نفخ ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause جعل.
The clause «جعل لكم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the first clause جعل.
The clause «تشكرون..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مهين): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the triliteral مهن, of the pattern كرم (category karuma), i.e. to be base and weak; its pattern is فعيل.

* Rhetoric:
In His saying, the Exalted, «فِي يَوْمٍ كانَ مِقْدارُهُ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِمَّا تَعُدُّونَ», i.e. in a prolonged stretch of time; the actual number is not what is meant. The prolonged duration was expressed by "the thousand" because it is the furthest of the ranks and the utmost of limits, and there is no rank above it, except the numbers of its ranks that branch out from it.

safi-cedvel:10-10.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval (inkārī) in both places, (في الأرض) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ضللنا), (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb, and its noun, (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), (في خلق) attached to the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, (بل) for iḍrāb (digression) of transition (intiqālī), (بلقاء) attached to the khabar (كافرون).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ضللنا ...» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).. and the condition, its verb and its apodosis are the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إنّا لفي خلق جديد..» has no grammatical position: an explication of the implied apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), i.e.: we will be resurrected, or we will be brought out [Note: it was not permitted to attach (إذا) to جديد — i.e. it was not valid for the clause إنّا لفي.. to be the apodosis — because what comes after إنّ does not govern what precedes it.].
The clause «هم ... كافرون..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

safi-cedvel:11-14.t:
* I'rab:
The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the verb (وكل) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو, and it is the linking pronoun, (بكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وكّل), (إلى ربّكم) attached to (ترجعون), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يتوفّاكم ملك ...» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «وكّل بكم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «ترجعون ...» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the speech reported.
(12) (الواو) conjunction, (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle, and the object of (ترى), which is of sight, is omitted, indicated by the mubtadaʾ (subject) after it, i.e.: المجرمون, (إذ) an adverb borrowed for future time, attached to (ترى) [Note: this is the explanation of Abū al-Baqāʾ.. or the adverb of the past (إذ) was used because the occurrence of the seeing is certain.], (عند) an adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (ناكسو), (ربّنا) the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative, (الفاء) conjunction, to link the effect to the cause, (نعمل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the response to the request, (صالحا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun).], (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb, and its noun..
The clause «لو ترى ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause قل..
The apodosis of لو is omitted, i.e.: you would have seen an amazing matter.
The clause «المجرمون ناكسو..» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The vocative clause and its response: in the position of an accusative as the speech reported of an implied verb of saying, which is in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: «يقولون ربّنا ...».
The clause «أبصرنا ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the vocative.
The clause «سمعنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the response to the vocative.
The clause «ارجعنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the response to the vocative.
The clause «نعمل ...» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ, i.e.: if You return us, we will do [righteousness]; so the clause has no grammatical position.
The clause «إنّا موقنون..» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
(13) (الواو) conjunction, (اللام) linking the apodosis of لو, (هداها) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, its sign of the accusative being the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, (الواو) conjunction, (لكن) for istidrāk (rectification), (منّي) attached to a ḥāl of القول, (اللام) the lām of the oath for an implied oath, (أملأن) an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative, (من الجنّة) attached to (أملأن), (أجمعين) a ḥāl, accusative, of الجنّة and الناس ...
The clause «لو شئنا..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لو ترى ...
The clause «آتينا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «حقّ القول ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause شئنا.
The clause «أملأنّ ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the implied oath [Note: the oath may be His saying: حقّ القول منّي, i.e. I swear I will surely fill.].
(14) (الفاء) conjunction, (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle, and the object of ذوقوا is omitted, i.e.:
taste the punishment [Note: the object may be the demonstrative (هذا), i.e. this punishment.], (هذا) a demonstrative in the position of a badal (substitute) of يومكم.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما نسيتم..) is in the position of a genitive by (الباء) — which is of causation — attached to (ذوقوا).
(ما كنتم) is like ما نسيتم.. and the interpreted maṣdar is like the first, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the second (ذوقوا).
The clause «ذوقوا ...» is conjoined to an implied speech reported of an implied verb of saying, i.e.: it was said to them: you abandoned faith, so taste....
The clause «إنّا نسيناكم ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical.
The clause «نسيناكم....» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «ذوقوا (the second)» is conjoined to the clause ذوقوا (the first).
The two clauses «نسيتم، كنتم ...» have no grammatical position: the ṣilas of the two particle-relatives (ما).
The clause «تعملون..» is in the position of an accusative as the khabar of كنتم.

* Morphology:
(12) ناكسو: plural of ناكس, an active participle from the triliteral نكس; its pattern is فاعل.
(14) الخلد: maṣdar of the triliteral خلد, of the pattern نصر (category naṣara); it is the noun from it meaning permanence and continuance; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
Shifting from the verbal to the nominal: in His saying, the Exalted, «ولو ترى إذ المجرمون ناكسو رؤسهم ... up to His saying, the Exalted, إنا موقنون».
It is a shift from the verbal clause to the emphasised nominal clause, to show their firmness in certainty and the completeness of their desire for it; all of that is for earnestness in the plea, out of hope of being answered in what they asked of the return — and how could that be theirs!

* Benefits:
(1) - The bare (mujarrad) and augmented (mazīd) verbs:
1- The bare verb: it is that all of whose letters are radical, none of which can be dispensed with; it is triliteral, such as: كتب - عدّ, and quadriliteral, such as: دحرج - عسكر.
2- The augmented: it is the verb to whose radical letters an addition of one, two or three letters has occurred:
a- The augmented triliteral: the triliteral is augmented by one, two or three letters:
1- Augmented by one letter, and it has three patterns:
a- أفعل: such as: أكرم - أحسن - أعلم..
b- فعّل: قدّم - نظّم - سوّى.
c- فاعل: شارك - نازل - سامح.
2- Augmented by two letters, and it has six patterns:
a- افتعل: اجتمع - انتصر - افتتح.
b- انفعل: انكسر - انقلب - اندفع.
c- تفاعل: تشارك - تمارض - تلاعب.
d- تفعّل: تقدّم - تنظّم - تعوّد.
e- افعلّ: احمرّ - اخضرّ.
and افعالّ: اصفارّ - احمارّ.
3- Augmented by three letters, and it has two patterns: a- استفعل: استخرج - استعمل - استخدم.
b- افعوعل: اخشوشن - اعشوشب - اخضوضر.
b- The augmented quadriliteral.
1- The quadriliteral is augmented by one letter, and it has one pattern:
تفعلل: تدحرج - تبعثر. 2- And it is augmented by two letters, and it has two patterns:
a- افعللّ: اقشعرّ - اطمأنّ - ادلهمّ.
b- افعنلل: احرنجم (meaning "gathered") افرنقع.
Remark:
1- The letters of augmentation are gathered in the word (سألتمونيها). 2- When judging a verb to be augmented or bare, we return it to the past tense and then judge it.
3- The prefixes of the imperfect, the attached pronouns, the nūn of emphasis or the tāʾ of the feminine that join the verb have no relation to augmentation or reduction; they are left out of the reckoning.
4- Augmentation is not only by adding a letter; it is also by doubling a letter: (فهم) becomes (فهّم), and this augmentation is called «doubling» (taḍʿīf). Or we say: the verb is augmented by doubling.
(2) - Emphasis with أجمعين:
(أجمعون) is distinguished among the words of semantic emphasis (tawkīd maʿnawī), and differs from its sisters, in that it does not need a pronoun attached to it referring back to the emphasised word, as has come in the verse we are dealing with, namely His saying, the Exalted, وَلكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّي لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ. But if «أجمعون» is preceded by an emphasis, it is regarded as an emphasis strengthening the first emphasis, as in His saying, the Exalted, فَسَجَدَ الْمَلائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ. As for كله, it is followed by أجمع, such as: (جاء الفريق كله أجمع). And كلها by جمعاء, such as (اشتركت العشير كلّها جمعاء), and كلهن by جمع, such as: عملت النسوة كلهن جمع. As for «جميعا», it comes as a ḥāl and is not parsed as tawkīd (emphasis).

safi-cedvel:15-18.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما) a restraining particle (kāffa) and a restrained one (makfūfa), (بآياتنا) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤمن), (بها) attached to (ذكّروا), (بحمد) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of سبّحوا, (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya), (لا) negative.
The clause «إنّما يؤمن بآياتنا..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «the condition, its verb and its apodosis..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «خرّوا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «سبّحوا....» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the apodosis.
The clause «هم لا يستكبرون..» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «لا يستكبرون..» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هم).
(16) (عن المضاجع) attached to (تتجافى), (خوفا) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) [Note: or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl.. or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; and likewise طمعا.], (مما) attached to (ينفقون), and the linking pronoun is omitted.
The clause «تتجافى جنوبهم..» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of سبّحوا [Note: it may be resumptive, so it has no grammatical position.].
The clause «يدعون..» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in جنوبهم [Note: it may be resumptive, so it has no grammatical position.].
The clause «رزقناهم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «ينفقون ...» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause لا يستكبرون [Note: or conjoined to the clause يدعون, taking its i'rab.].
(17) (الفاء) conjunction, (لا) negative, (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: or an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ, and the clause after it is the khabar, and the interrogative clause is the object of تعلم, since the verb is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.], and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the verb (أخفي) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو, referring to ما, (لهم) attached to (أخفي), (من قرّة) attached to a ḥāl of the pronoun of the nāʾib fāʿil, (جزاء) mafʿūl li-ajlihi, accusative, its governor being أخفي [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, i.e.: they were recompensed with a recompense.], (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: or a relative noun, in the position of a genitive, the governor being omitted.].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا ...) is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ — which is of causation — attached to جزاء.
The clause «لا تعلم نفس ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إنّما يؤمن ...
The clause «أخفي ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «كانوا يعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative or the nominal relative (ما).
The clause «يعملون..» is in the position of an accusative as the khabar of كانوا.
(18) (الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval (inkārī), (الفاء) conjunction, (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative as a mubtadaʾ, (كمن) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من, (لا) negative.
The clause «من كان مؤمنا..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the first relative (من).
The clause «كان فاسقا..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (من).
The clause «لا يستوون..» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).

* Morphology:
(تتجافى): it contains an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its origin is تتجافي with a yāʾ at its end; the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was changed into an alif; and the alif's origin is a wāw in the triliteral.

* Benefits:
- The single kāf:
It is the one that makes genitive, and it divides into a particle and a noun. As for the particle, it has five meanings:
1- Likening (tashbīh), as in «زيد كالأسد» and His saying, the Exalted, أَفَمَنْ كانَ مُؤْمِناً كَمَنْ كانَ فاسِقاً.
2- Causation (taʿlīl): some affirmed it and most denied it; its example is His saying, the Exalted, وَيْكَأَنَّهُ لا يُفْلِحُ الْكافِرُونَ, i.e. I wonder at their not prospering, and His saying, the Exalted, كَما أَرْسَلْنا فِيكُمْ رَسُولًا; al-Akhfash said: on account of My sending among you a messenger.
3- Being over (istiʿlāʾ): al-Akhfash and the Kufans mentioned it, and [reported] that one of them was asked: How are you this morning? and he said: كخير, i.e. on good. It was said the meaning is: بخير (well), and it was said: it is for likening with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. like one possessing good.
4- Promptness (mubādara): that is when it is joined to (ما), as in (سلم كما تدخل) (give greeting as soon as you enter) and (وصلّ كما يدخل الوقت) (pray as soon as the time comes in).
5- Emphasis (tawkīd): it is the redundant one (zāʾida), as in His saying, the Exalted, لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ.
As for the nominal kāf that makes genitive, it is synonymous with مثل (like), and it occurs only in poetic necessity, as in the saying of al-ʿAjjāj:
بيض ثلاث كنعاج جمّ ... يضحكن عن كالبرد المنهمّ
(Three fair ones, like hornless ewes, who smile showing [teeth] like melting hail.)
المنهمّ: melting; and the evidence is his saying: كالبرد, i.e. like hail. Many, among them al-Akhfash and al-Fārisī, said: it is permitted in free choice (ikhtiyār), so they permitted in such as «زيد كالأسد» that the kāf be in the position of a nominative as a khabar meaning مثل, with الأسد as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

safi-cedvel:19-21.t:
* I'rab:
(أمّا) a particle of condition and detailing, (الواو) conjunction, and (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), (لهم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) جنّات, (نزلا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of جنّات, (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (ما كانوا ...) is in the position of a genitive by (الباء) — which is of causation — attached to the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) which is the khabar.
The clause «الذين آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «عملوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause آمنوا..
The clause «لهم جنّات ...» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «يعملون..» is in the position of an accusative as the khabar of كانوا.
(20) (الواو) conjunction, (أمّا ... النار) like أما ... جنّات, (كلّما) an adverb containing the sense of condition, in the position of an accusative, attached to the apodosis أعيدوا, (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle, (منها) attached to (يخرجوا), and (الواو) in (أعيدوا) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), (فيها) attached to (أعيدوا), (لهم) attached to (قيل), (الذي) a naʿt (adjective) of (عذاب), (به) attached to (تكذّبون).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخرجوا..) is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being أرادوا.
The clause «الذين فسقوا..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «فسقوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «مأواهم النار..» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «الذين».
The clause «أرادوا....» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «يخرجوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «أعيدوا فيها..» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «قيل لهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the apodosis.
The clause «ذوقوا ...» is in the position of a nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil [Note: originally it is the clause of the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).].
The clause «كنتم به تكذّبون..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «تكذّبون..» is in the position of an accusative as the khabar of كنتم.
(21) (الواو) conjunction, (اللام) the lām of the oath for an implied oath, (نذيقنّهم) an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative.. and (النون) is for emphasis, and (هم) is the mafʿūl bihi, (من العذاب) attached to (نذيقنّهم), (دون) an adverb, accusative, attached to (نذيقنّهم).
The clause «نذيقنّهم..» has no grammatical position: the response to the implied oath. And the implied oath clause has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «لعلّهم يرجعون..» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يرجعون..» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.

safi-cedvel:22-22.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (من) an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject) in the position of a nominative, its khabar (predicate) being (أظلم), (ممّن) attached to (mutaʿalliq) أظلم, (بآيات) attached to (ذكّر), (عنها) attached to (أعرض), (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb, and its noun, (من المجرمين) attached to (منتقمون).
The clause «من أظلم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ذكّر ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «أعرض عنها ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «إنّا ... منتقمون.» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).

* Morphology:
(منتقمون): plural of منتقم, an active participle from the five-letter verb انتقم; its pattern is مفتعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
The conjunctions have secrets, so it is not valid to put some of them in the place of others, because of the differences between them; and the word ثم in His saying, the Exalted, «ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْها» is for expressing unlikelihood (istibʿād).
The meaning: turning away from the like of Allah's signs — in their clarity, their illumination and their guidance to the right path and to winning the supreme happiness — after being reminded of them is something unlikely in reason and in justice; just as you say to your companion: you found such an opportunity, then (ثم) you did not seize it — expressing how unlikely it was that he would leave off seizing it.

safi-cedvel:23-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (اللام) the lām of the oath for an implied oath, (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq), (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition, (لا) prohibitive, making jussive, (في مرية) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of تكن, (من لقائه) attached to مرية [Note: on the referent of the pronoun the exegetes have many views.], and the third-person pronoun in (جعلناه) refers to Moses — or to the Book —, (هدى) a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being جعلناه, (لبني) attached to هدى.
The clause «آتينا ...» has no grammatical position: the response to the implied oath ... and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا تكن في مرية ...» is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you ask about it, then do not be.. [Note: and the clause of the condition and its apodosis has no grammatical position: parenthetical.].
The clause «جعلناه ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the response to the oath.
(24) (الواو) conjunction in both places, (منهم) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi, its governor being جعلنا, (بأمرنا) attached to (يهدون), (لمّا) an indeclinable (mabnī) adverb containing the sense of condition — or stripped of the condition — attached to the content of the apodosis — or to (جعلنا) —, (بآياتنا) attached to (يوقنون).
The clause «جعلنا....» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the response to the oath.
The clause «يهدون ...» is in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of أئمة.
The clause «صبروا....» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «كانوا ... يوقنون..» is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause صبروا..
The clause «يوقنون..» is in the position of an accusative as the khabar of كانوا.
(25) (هو) a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is the clause يفصل, (بينهم) an adverb, accusative, attached to (يفصل), (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يفصل), (في ما) attached to (يفصل), (فيه) attached to (يختلفون).
The clause «إنّ ربّك ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «هو يفصل ...» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «يفصل ...» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of (هو).
The clause «كانوا.. يختلفون.» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «يختلفون..» is in the position of an accusative as the khabar of كانوا.

safi-cedvel:26-27.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for the interrogative of disapproval (inkārī), (الواو) conjunction, (لهم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يهد) in the sense of "become clear", and the pronoun in it refers to the people of Mecca, and the fāʿil (agent) of يهد is omitted, indicated by the context of speech in His saying أهلكناه, i.e.: has not Our destroying become clear to them.. (من قبلهم) attached to (أهلكنا) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of القرون.], (من القرون) the tamyīz (specification) of كم, (في مساكنهم) attached to (يمشون), (في ذلك) attached to the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, (اللام) for emphasis, (الهمزة) for the interrogative of rebuke (taqrīʿī), (الفاء) conjunction, (لا) negative.
The clause «لم يهد ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.:
were they heedless, and has it not become clear ...
The clause «أهلكنا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or an explication of the fāʿil —. The clause «يمشون ...» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl of القرون [Note: or of the pronoun in (لهم).. and it may be resumptive, so it has no grammatical position.].
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يسمعون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.:
has deafness struck them, so that they do not hear.
(أولم يروا) is like أولم يهد.. (أنّا) a particle resembling the verb, and its noun, (إلى الأرض) attached to (نسوق), (به) attached to (نخرج), and (الباء) is of causation, (منه) attached to (تأكل), (أفلا يبصرون) like أفلا يسمعون.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أنّا نسوق ...) is in the position of an accusative, standing in place of the two objects of يروا..
The clause «لم يروا..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لم يهد.
The clause «نسوق ...» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of أنّ.
The clause «نخرج ...» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause نسوق.
The clause «تأكل منه أنعامهم..» is in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (زرعا).
The clause «يبصرون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.:
has blindness struck them, so that they do not see.

* Morphology:
(الجرز): an assimilated adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from جرزت تجرز الأرض — of the pattern فرح (category fariḥa) — meaning that it does not grow [vegetation], or its vegetation has been eaten; its pattern is فعل with two ḍammas; its plural is أجراز.

* Rhetoric:
The art of correspondence (al-munāsaba): in His saying, the Exalted, «أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ» — the verse.
Correspondence is of two kinds: either correspondence in meanings, or correspondence in wordings; what concerns us in this verse is the first kind, and its definition is: that the speaker begins with a meaning, then completes his speech with what corresponds to it in meaning, not in wording.
For He, the Exalted, said at the head of the verse: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ, and it is an admonition by hearing, since they had not looked upon the destroyed generations but had only heard of them; so it was fitting that He bring after it His saying «أَفَلا يَسْمَعُونَ». As for after the visible admonition, which is His saying after this verse «أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا نَسُوقُ الْماءَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ», it was fitting that He say «أَفَلا يُبْصِرُونَ», because crops are seen, not heard — so that the end of each speech corresponds to its beginning.

* Benefits:
- Removing a misconception:
Among the misconceptions about this verse is the saying of Ibn ʿUṣfūr, regarding His saying, the Exalted, in this verse أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنا, that (كم) is the fāʿil of يهد. If you say: he derived it according to a dialect that al-Akhfash reported, namely that some Arabs do not insist on the predicative (khabariyya) (كم) coming first, I say: he admitted its poor quality, so deriving the Revelation upon it after that is poor. The correct view is that the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), referring to Allah, Glorified and Exalted is He, i.e. has not Allah made clear to them, or to guidance; the first is the saying of Abū al-Baqāʾ and the second the saying of al-Zajjāj. Al-Zamakhsharī said: the fāʿil is the clause — and it has preceded that the fāʿil cannot be a clause — and «كم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أهلكنا, and the clause is the object of يهد, which is suspended (muʿallaq) from it; «and the predicative كم causes suspension, contrary to most of them». Imam al-Nasafī mentioned that the fāʿil is Allah, Mighty and Majestic, as evidenced by the reading of Zayd from Yaʿqūb (أولم تهد لهم).

safi-cedvel:28-28.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, (متى) an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هذا, (الفتح) a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) —, (كنتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ)..
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «متى هذا الفتح ...» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كنتم صادقين..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

safi-cedvel:29-30.t:
* I'rab:
(يوم) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (لا ينفع), (لا) negative, (الذين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is (إيمانهم), (الواو) conjunction, (لا) like the first, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) in (ينظرون) is the wāw.
The clause «قل....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا ينفع ... إيمانهم.» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا هم ينظرون ...» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause لا ينفع.
The clause «ينظرون..» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هم).
(30) (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition, (عنهم) attached to (أعرض), (الواو) conjunction.
The clause «أعرض عنهم ...» is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.:
if they turn away from you, then turn away.
The clause «انتظر....» is conjoined to the clause أعرض....
The clause «إنّهم منتظرون ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or causal (taʿlīliyya) —.
